# South Wales Tutoring

> Delivering a better future through personalised online tutoring across South Wales.

Official website: https://southwalestutoring.com/
Enquiries: southwales@nwttutoring.com
WhatsApp messages: https://wa.me/447480231362
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/southwalestutoring/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/southwalestutoring/
Associated group: https://nwttutoring.com/

South Wales Tutoring arranges live, one-to-one online tutoring with UK tutors. Tuition is offered to families in Cardiff, Swansea, Newport, Bridgend, the South Wales Valleys, Rhondda Cynon Taf, Caerphilly, Merthyr Tydfil, Vale of Glamorgan, Neath Port Talbot, Carmarthenshire, and surrounding communities. These are ONLINE service areas, not physical tutoring centres.

Subjects: Maths, Further Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Combined Science, English, languages and additional subjects, subject to tutor availability.

Levels and examinations: Primary, KS3, SATs, 11+, 13+, GCSE, AS-Level, A-Level, TMUA and UCAT. The tutor network supports WJEC, Eduqas, AQA, Edexcel, OCR and CAIE where applicable. Welsh-medium teaching is subject to tutor matching.

Published general starting rates: GCSE from £23 per hour and A-Level from £28 per hour. Individual tutors can charge different rates; exact price and availability must be confirmed before booking. No guaranteed outcomes are claimed.
